title: Simple vs compound interest
problem: \$5000 is invested for 3 years. Option A earns 6% per annum simple interest. Option B earns 5.8% per annum compound interest, compounded annually. Which option gives a higher final value?

steps.instruction: Calculate the final value under Option A (simple interest).
Calculate the final value under Option B (compound interest).

steps.working:
Option A: \$5900.00

Option B: \$5922.32

Option B gives \$22.32 more over 3 years.

answer: Option B (compound at 5.8%) gives a higher final value of \$5922.32, compared to \$5900.00 for Option A (simple at 6%).

title: Shares, dividend yield and total return
problem:
An investor buys 200 shares at \$8.40 each. After one year the share price is \$9.10 and the company pays a dividend of \$0.25 per share.
(a) Calculate the dividend yield at the time of purchase.
(b) Calculate the investor's total profit.

steps.instruction: Sum the capital gain and dividends for total profit.
